cl_f_L_per_hr.note: Approximate steady-state apparent oral clearance for lorlatinib; clearance increases from about 11 L/h after a single dose due to autoinduction.

t_half_hr.note: Approximate reported lorlatinib elimination half-life after a single dose; used as an estimate for the model.

tau_hr.note: Planned oral dosing is once daily.

fu.note: Estimated from approximately 66% plasma protein binding.

ic50_nM.note: Approximate cellular IC50 against wild-type ALK; potency varies across resistance mutations.

mw.note: Molecular weight of lorlatinib in g/mol.
